khaosDeck.name: Khaos Archer
khaosDeck.effect: Each Time This Card Declares An Attack On A Creature, It Gains 20 War Points.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Lander
khaosDeck.effect: When This Card Is Summoned Deal 50 Damage to Your Opponents HP For Each Card On Their Side Of The Field.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Defender
khaosDeck.effect: While This Card Is On Your Field, It Gains 20 HP Each Time A Card Is Destroyed.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Raider
khaosDeck.effect: On The Turn This Card Is Summoned, It May Declare War Twice That Turn.

khaosDeck.name: Super Magical Troop
khaosDeck.effect: When This Card Is Sent To The Core, Draw 2 Cards.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Swordsman
khaosDeck.effect: Immediatley After This Card Is Summoned, For Every Card On The Field This Card Gains 20 War Points.

khaosDeck.name: Panda Person
khaosDeck.effect: When This Card Is Sent To The Core, Your Opponent Loses 100 Health.

khaosDeck.name: Simple Bug
khaosDeck.effect: Whilst This Card Is On The Field, All Creatures Of The'Bug' Archetype Gain 30 War Points.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Mage
khaosDeck.effect: When This Card Is Summoned, You Can Choose Any Creature In Your Hand, Deck Or Core, And This Cards Name Becomes The Name Of That Card, This Card Gains The War Points And Hp Of That Card. If The Card Selected Was Selected From Your Hand Or Deck, Immediately Send That Card To The Core.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Curse
khaosDeck.effect: When A Khaos Creature Is Destroyed, You Can Activate This Card From Your Hand And Deal Your Opponent 300 Points Of Damage To Their Health.

khaosDeck.name: Energy Drink
khaosDeck.effect: During Your Turn, You Can Activate This Card From The Hand And Select One Creature On Your Side Of The Field: That Card Can Declare War Twice This Turn.

khaosDeck.name: Final Bullet
khaosDeck.effect: Select One Creature On Either Side Of The Field And Send That Creature To The Core.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Axe
khaosDeck.effect: This Card Can Only Be Equipped To A Khaos Creature. Select A Khaos Creature On The Field And Equip This Card To It. While This Card Is Equipped To A Creature, The Equipped Creature Gains 50 War Points And 50 Health Points. That Creature's Attribute Also Becomes Melee.

khaosDeck.name: Soul Drain
khaosDeck.effect: Select Two Creature's On Either Side Of The Field. The First Selected Creature's War Point's Are Reduced To Zero And Its Health Points Reduced To 10. The Second Selected Creatures Gains War And Health Points Equal To The Amount That The First Creature's War Point's And Health Point's Were Reduced By Respectively.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Guardian
khaosDeck.effect: This Card Cannot Be Summoned Except For By Its Own Effect. This Card Can Be Summoned From The Hand Or Core To Your Side Of The Field By Discarding One Khaos Creature From Your Hand To The Core While Your Banners Are Equal To One.

khaosDeck.name: Evil Rites
khaosDeck.effect: When You Would lose Banner(s) Due To An Effect, You Can Activate This Card From The Hand. You Do Not Lose Any Banners And Instead Gain Banners Equal To The Number Of Banners You Would Have Lost.

khaosDeck.name: Mark Of Khaos
khaosDeck.effect: If You Control A Khaos Creature, You Can Activate This Card From Your Hand And Select One Khaos Creature You Control, Pay 1 Banner And Select 1 Card Of The Khaos Archetype In Your Hand Deck Or Core. The Creature Selected From The Field's Name Becomes The Selected Creatures Name.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Overlord
khaosDeck.effect: When Your Opponent Activates The Effect Of A Creature, Pay 1 Banner And If You Do, Negate That Effect. If This Cards First Effect Resolves, You May Then Target One Creature On Your Field And Send It To The Core And Summon This Card From Your Hand (Irrespective Of Your Normal Summon).

khaosDeck.name: Khaos General
khaosDeck.effect: You Can Summon This Card From Your Hand Irrespective Of Your Normal Summon By Discarding 2 Cards From Your Hand To The Core. Immediatley After This Card Is Summoned To Your Side Of The Field, Draw 2 Cards: If One At Least Of The Drawn Cards Is Of The Khaos Archetype Keep Both, Otherwise Discard Both To The Core.

khaosDeck.name: Clan Of Khaos
khaosDeck.effect: If You Control A Rank 2 Or Rank 3 Khaos Creature On Your Side Of The Field, You Can Activate This Card From Your Hand And Pay 300 Health Points. After This You May Select One Khaos Creature From Your Deck And Add It To Your Hand.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Vessle Of War
khaosDeck.effect: If This Card Is On Your Side Of The Field, During Each Of Your Turns It Must Declare War Or You Lose 2 Banners. If This Card Is Sent From The Field To The Core, Select One Khaos Creature In The Core Other Than This Card And Add That Target To The Hand.

khaosDeck.name: Healing Property Of Dark
khaosDeck.effect: When You Would Lose Banner(s) For Whatever Reason, You Can Activate This Card From Your Hand And You Do Not Lose Any Banners And Instead Gain One Banner. Immediatley After This You Must Discard The Top Card Of Your Deck To The Core Repeatedly Until You Discard A Card Of The Khaos Archetype.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Marauderer
khaosDeck.effect: When A Khaos Creature Is Sent From The Field To The Core, Discard This Card From The Hand To The Core And Summon That Card Back To Your Side Of The Field.

khaosDeck.name: Binding Symbiote
khaosDeck.effect: Equip To Two Creatures From Either Side Of The Field. If This Card Or One Of The Equipped Creatures Are Sent To The Core While This Card Is Equipped To Them, Send Both Creatures To The Core. Change The War Points And HP Of Both Equipped Creatures To The War Points And HP Of The Highest Value Intravenously Between The Cards.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Entity
khaosDeck.effect: Select One Khaos Creature On Your Field And Send That Card To The Core And Lose 2 Banners. Summon A Rank 2 Or Rank 3 Creature Of The Khaos Archetype From Your Deck To Your Side Of The Field. This Effect Can Be Activated As Many Times As You Like While This Card Is Face Up On The Field Or You Can Discard This Card From Your Hand To The Core To Activate This Effect.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Sorceror Of Grand Destruction
khaosDeck.effect: Pay 1 Banner And Select 2 Creatures On The Field, One From Your Side Of The Field And One From Your Opponents Side. Send Both Creatures To The Core And Deal You Opponent Damage To Their Health Points Equal To The Combined War Points Of Those Cards Divided By 2.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Berserker
khaosDeck.effect: Any Damage This Card Deals To Your Opponents Health Is Doubled. You May Send A Khaos Creature From Your Side Of The Field To The Core And This Card Gains War Points Equal To Half That Cards War Points.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Agent Of Evil
khaosDeck.effect: You May Pay One Banner And Send This Card From Your Hand To The Core And Select One Khaos Bond Card From Your Special Deck And Select One Of The Specifically Listed Materials On It That Is In Your Deck Or Core. Add That Card To Your Hand.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Symbiote
khaosDeck.effect: Equip This Card To A Khaos Creature Only. The Equipped Creature's War Points Become 0 And It Gains HP Equal To Its Lost War Points. While Equipped, That Creature Cannot Be Sent To The Core By Card Effects.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Envoy Of Supreme Annihilation
khaosDeck.effect: From The Hand, Equip This Card To A Creature Of The Khaos Archetype On Your Side Of The Field And That Equipped Creature's War Points And HP Double. At The End Of Each Turn While This Card Is Equipped To A Creature, You Lose One Banner Unless You Have On, In Which Case You Stay At One.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Knight
khaosDeck.effect: If You Control No Creatures, Discard One Card From Your Hand To The Core And Select A Creature In The Core And Summon It To Your Side Of The Field.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Militant
khaosDeck.effect: Send One Material To The Core: Add One Khaos Creature From Your Deck To Your Hand. If This Card Is Sent To The Core, Gain 1 Banner.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Dragon Star
khaosDeck.effect: Upon This Cards Summon, All Creatures Your Opponent Controls Change Their War Pts To 0. Send One Material To The Core: This Card Can Attack Twice This Turn.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Warrior Of The Shining Abyss
khaosDeck.effect: Send One Material To The Core: Select Any 1 Creature On The Field And Double That Creature's War Points.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Ultimate Warrior Of The End
khaosDeck.effect: This Card Deals Double Damage When Dealing Damage To Your Opponents Health Points. Send One Material To The Core: This Card Can Declare War This Turn As Many Times As Equal To The Number Of Cards In Your Hand.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Ultimate Star Warrior
khaosDeck.effect: Send One Material To The Core: This Turn, This Card Can Attack All Of Your Opponents Creatures

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Guardian Of The End Entity
khaosDeck.effect: Your Opponent Cannot Target This Card When Declaring War. Send Two Materials To The Core: Your Opponent Loses Banners Equal To The Number Of Creatures On Their Side Of The Field.

khaosDeck.name: Khaos Entity: Envoy The End
khaosDeck.effect: Upon This Cards Summon, Destroy All Creatures On The Field Except This Card. Your Opponent Loses Health Points Equal To The Combined War Points Of The Destroyed Creatures.
